pending_advance_plan.title: Make the four standalone toggle switches keyboard- and screen-reader-operable
pending_advance_plan.why: index.html의 4곳(2457: 자산 '총자산에 포함', 2881: 조정 내역 '수지에 포함', 2973: 반복 이체 '자동 확인', 3717: 시세 '자동 갱신')이 <span class="switch" onclick=...>로만 렌더링돼 tabindex/role/aria-checked가 전혀 없다. span은 기본적으로 포커스도 키보드 활성화도 안 되므로, 이 네 개는 앱에서 마우스/터치 없이는 아예 조작 불가능한 유일한 컨트롤이다(cycle9는 라벨 누락만 고쳤지, 이건 조작 자체가 불가능한 더 심한 케이스). 모두 실질적인 상태를 게이팅한다(순자산 포함 여부, 월 수지 포함 여부, 이체 자동확인, 시세 자동갱신).
pending_advance_plan.approach: 1) 각 <span class="switch ...">를 <button type="button" class="switch ...">로 변경(네이티브 포커스+Enter/Space 활성화, UA 기본 스타일 리셋 필요시 border:0;background:none;padding:0 추가). 2) 렌더 시 role="switch"와 aria-checked="${state?'true':'false'}"를 기존에 이미 계산돼 있는 on/off 상태(d.includeInTotal, t.inSurplus, d.autoConfirm!==false, DB.settings.autoRates)로 템플릿. 3) 시각 라벨이 없으므로 aria-label 추가(예: '총자산에 포함', '수지에 포함', '이체 자동 확인', '10분마다 자동 갱신'). 4) 기존 inline onclick 핸들러의 this.classList.toggle('on') 옆에 this.setAttribute('aria-checked', this.classList.contains('on')) 한 줄씩 추가. 5) menu-item 버튼 안에 이미 들어있는 나머지 .switch 인스턴스(~3402/3429)도 부모가 이미 버튼이라 키보드 도달은 되지만, 일관성을 위해 aria-checked만 같이 추가. 6) 수동 테스트: 자산 등록/수정, 잔액 조정, 반복 설정, 시세 연동 관리 시트에서 Tab으로 이동 후 Space/Enter로 토글되고 시각 상태와 aria-checked가 같이 바뀌는지 확인. build/test: node --check로 두 인라인 <script> 파싱 확인, node test/run.js 회귀 통과 확인(순수 로직 미변경이라 새 테스트 불필요할 가능성 높음).

history.summary: 전체 앱을 한 걸음 물러나 봤다(백그라운드 조사 에이전트 활용, 이미 고쳐진 항목들은 제외하고 재조사). 발견: index.html의 네 개 독립 토글 스위치(2457줄 자산 "총자산에 포함", 2881줄 조정 내역 "수지에 포함", 2973줄 반복 이체 "자동 확인", 3717줄 시세 "자동 갱신")가 <span class="switch" onclick=...>로만 구현돼 tabindex/role/aria-checked가 전혀 없음을 확인 -- span은 기본적으로 포커스도 키보드 활성화도 안 되므로 마우스/터치 없이는 아예 조작이 불가능한, cycle9에서 고친 라벨 누락보다 더 심한 케이스. 함께 검토했지만 기각한 후보: 로컬 탭 간 storage 이벤트 미구현(멀티탭은 소수 사용 케이스라 범위가 덜 명확함), saveTx()의 금액 검증(num()이 이미 비숫자를 걸러내므로 실제 버그 아님). 코드 변경 없음 -- pending_advance_plan에 토글 스위치 접근성 계획을 적어둠.

Reviewed commit a9239e2 (deleteRecsUndo — routes delRecConfirm() and recApply(mode='delete',scope='all') through the same twGuard+undo infra as deleteTxnsUndo/deleteAssetsUndo). Verified deleteRecsUndo(ids) (index.html:4878) gates on twGuard() first, snapshots removed recurrences via DB.recurrences.filter before removing them, and its undo callback re-pushes the same object references and re-saves -- identical shape to deleteTxnsUndo. Confirmed both call sites match the existing delTx/delAdjust closeSheet-then-delete ordering (confirmSheet's own OK button already calls closeSheet() before invoking the delRecConfirm callback; recApply's own closeSheet() call precedes deleteRecsUndo(), same as before the change). Grepped every remaining DB.recurrences write site and confirmed no other direct-filter delete path bypasses deleteRecsUndo -- recApply's 'one'/'future' scopes are genuinely partial edits (skip-push / endDate pull-in), not deletes, so correctly left untouched. Re-ran the regression suite (58/58 pass) and re-verified both inline <script> blocks parse via new Function(). No bugs found -- no code changes this phase.

delRecConfirm(id) (index.html:3020, 반복 내역 관리 화면의 삭제 버튼)와 recApply(mode='delete',scope='all') (index.html:2904-2908, 원장/히스토리에서 특정 반복 인스턴스를 탭해 '전체' 범위로 삭제하는 경로)가 delTx/delAdjust가 cycle9-10에서 이미 고친 것과 정확히 같은 버그 패턴을 갖고 있었다: DB.recurrences를 직접 filter로 지우고 되돌리기 없는 plain toast만 보여줘 twGuard(튜토리얼 가드)도 건너뛰었다. deleteTxnsUndo/deleteAssetsUndo와 같은 자리(4875줄 부근)에 deleteRecsUndo(ids)를 새로 추가해(twGuard 체크 + 6초 undo 토스트 + 복원 콜백) 두 진입점 모두 이걸 쓰도록 통일했다. recApply의 나머지 두 scope('one'=해당 날짜만 skip, 'future'=종료일만 당김)는 전체 삭제가 아니라 부분 수정이라 범위가 달라 이번 사이클에서는 건드리지 않음(다음 critique 후보로 남을 수 있음). test/run.js에 deleteRecsUndo를 추출 대상에 추가하고 삭제+undo 복원, 튜토리얼 중 삭제 차단 케이스 2개 추가 -- 58/58 테스트 통과. 두 인라인 <script> 블록 모두 new Function()으로 파싱 확인. APP_VERSION 1.19.6->1.19.7, sw.js CACHE v49->v50 (patch bump, bug fix).

cycle10 critique 계획대로 delAdjust(id) (index.html~2887)를 delTx와 동일하게 deleteTxnsUndo(new Set([id]))를 쓰도록 통일했다. 기존에는 DB.txns.filter로 직접 삭제하고 되돌리기 없는 plain toast만 보여줘 twGuard(튜토리얼 가드)도 건너뛰었는데, 이제 형제 삭제 경로(delTx/ledgerDelSel/histDelSel)와 동일하게 튜토리얼 중 삭제를 막고 6초짜리 되돌리기 토스트로 조정 내역도 복원 가능해졌다. deleteTxnsUndo가 지금까지 어떤 회귀 테스트로도 커버되지 않고 있었으므로 test/run.js에 twActive/twGuard/deleteTxnsUndo를 추출 대상에 추가하고(undoToast/TWi 스텁 신설), 삭제+undo 복원 케이스와 튜토리얼 중 삭제 차단 케이스 2개를 추가 -- 56/56 테스트 통과. 두 인라인 <script> 블록 모두 new Function()으로 파싱 확인. APP_VERSION 1.19.5->1.19.6, sw.js CACHE v48->v49 (patch bump, bug fix).

전체 앱을 한 걸음 물러나 봤다(백그라운드 조사 에이전트 활용). delAdjust(id) (index.html:2887-2888)가 cycle10 develop에서 이미 고친 delTx의 버그 패턴을 형제 함수로서 여전히 갖고 있음을 확인: DB.txns를 직접 filter하고 되돌리기 없는 plain toast만 보여주며, deleteTxnsUndo가 제공하는 twGuard()(튜토리얼 가드)와 6초 undo 토스트를 전혀 받지 못한다. 실제 도달 경로(openAdjustEdit -> '이 조정 내역 삭제' 버튼)가 있는 진짜 회귀 가능 버그라 다음 advance 사이클 대상으로 선정. 후보로 검토했지만 기각한 것들: 큰 render 함수들(renderPlan 57줄 등)은 파일 전체가 원래 조밀한 스타일이라 명확한 문제로 보기 어려움; 환율/시세 fetch 에러 처리(fetchFxGold/fetchStocks/syncRates)는 이미 Promise.allSettled와 per-source 실패 카운터로 견고하게 구현됨; TODO/FIXME나 예전 cash-flow-curve 같은 새로운 고아 코드는 전체 grep에서 발견되지 않음. 코드 변경 없음 -- pending_advance_plan에 delAdjust 통일 계획을 적어둠.

Reviewed commit 7c3c59f (delTx now routes through deleteTxnsUndo instead of hand-rolled filter+plain-toast). Verified deleteTxnsUndo(ids) (index.html:4876) correctly gates on twGuard() first, snapshots the removed row via DB.txns.filter before removing it, and its undo callback re-pushes the exact same object reference and re-saves -- so a single-item delete now gets the identical 6-second undo affordance bulk delete already had, with no behavior change to the tutorial-mode guard bypass risk (delTx previously skipped twGuard entirely; now it doesn't, which is the intended fix, not a side effect to worry about). Confirmed delTx's only call site (the ledger row detail sheet's delete button, index.html:2793) passes a single id and expects no return value, which still holds. Checked deleteTxnsUndo has no other caller whose behavior could be altered by delTx now sharing it (ledgerDelSel/histDelSel are the only other callers, unaffected). Re-ran the regression suite (54/54 pass) and re-verified both inline <script> blocks parse via new Function(). No bugs found -- no code changes this phase.

Found a real, scoped accessibility gap: openSheet()'s default close button (index.html ~4120, class .sheet-x) is the icon-only ${svg('x')} button rendered on virtually every modal/sheet in the app whenever no custom topBtn is passed — by far the single most-used interactive control in the whole UI — and it had zero text alternative for screen readers, unlike most named buttons elsewhere. The picker back button (.pk-back, ~4894, used in every openPicker() screen) had the same gap. Accessibility had been flagged as a real but 'diffuse/low-priority' runner-up in critique cycles 6-8 and never acted on because it read as too broad for one cycle; these two are the two highest-reach, lowest-risk instances (each defined exactly once, used everywhere) so fixing just these two closes most of the practical gap without touching any business logic. Added aria-label="닫기" to .sheet-x and aria-label="뒤로" to .pk-back. Pure HTML-attribute change, no JS logic touched, so no new regression tests needed — ran the full existing suite (49/49 pass) and re-verified both inline <script> blocks parse via new Function(). Bumped APP_VERSION 1.19.2→1.19.3 and sw.js CACHE v45→v46 (patch bump, accessibility fix).

Implemented cycle 8's critique plan: added a pure totalBudgetSummary(rows,budgets) that, given spendByCategory() rows and DB.budgets, sums budgetedTotal/spentOnBudgeted across only the categories that have a budget set, counts overCount (categories over their budget) and unsetCount (categories with spending but no budget), and returns budgetedTotal=0 when no budgets exist at all (nothing to aggregate). Wired it into openSpendAnalysis(): when budgetedTotal>0, a second summary card renders above the per-category list showing '{budget}원 중 {spent}원 사용 · {pct}%' (reusing budgetProgress() for the percentage/over-budget math and the existing .spend-track bar styling) plus a small '예산 미설정 카테고리 N개' note when unsetCount>0; when the user hasn't set any budget yet, no card is added and the screen is unchanged from before. Added 4 new regression tests to test/run.js (all-unset returns budgetedTotal=0, mixed set/unset only sums the set ones, overCount counts categories exceeding their budget, and DB.budgets===undefined doesn't throw) — all 49 tests pass. Verified both inline <script> blocks still parse via new Function(). Bumped APP_VERSION 1.19.1→1.19.2 and sw.js CACHE v44→v45 (patch bump, additive UI feature reusing existing data/helpers).

전체 앱을 한 걸음 물러나 봤다. 접근성(aria-label 5개뿐, role/alt/tabindex 0개)과 로컬 인증 해시 우려는 이전 사이클(6,7)에서 이미 runner-up으로 반복 언급됐지만, 실제로 코드를 확인해보니 인증은 djb2 로컬 해시가 아니라 Supabase Auth(SB.auth.signUp/signInWithPassword)로 완전히 대체돼 있었다 — 그 runner-up은 더 이상 유효하지 않아 폐기. 대신 cycle 5에서 만든 예산 기능(DB.budgets, openSpendAnalysis 카테고리별 진행률)이 카테고리 단위로만 존재하고 '이번 달 전체적으로 예산 안에서 쓰고 있는가'를 한눈에 보여주는 집계 뷰가 없다는 점을 발견 — openSpendAnalysis()의 '총 지출' 카드(3524줄)는 예산 개념 없이 순수 합계만 보여준다. rateStatusText()/autoSyncRates()의 환율 동기화 실패 처리, delAsset()의 반복거래 연쇄 비활성화, importData()의 검증 등 다른 후보들은 이미 견고하게 구현돼 있음을 확인하고 제외했다. 코드 변경 없음 — pending_advance_plan에 예산 총액 요약 카드 계획을 적어둠.

Reviewed commit 8121371 (yearly recDates() Feb-29 clamp fix). Traced through the rewritten loop by hand: mo/day are captured once from rs, d2=Math.min(day,lastDay(y,mo)) correctly clamps per-year (lastDay(y,m)=new Date(y,m,0).getDate() is the same helper already used by the monthly branch and addMonths()), the break condition new Date(y,mo-1,d2)>end terminates since the constructed date strictly increases with y, and ds>=r.startDate/push()'s own from/to/endDate bounds are unchanged from before so windowing behavior is preserved. Checked all 5 call sites of recDates() (index.html:1705,1725,1730,2511,4573) — all consume the returned array the same way as before (forEach/.length/direct array use), so the return type/shape didn't change. Re-ran the regression suite (45/45 pass) and re-validated both inline <script> blocks parse via new Function(). No bugs found — no code changes this phase. Also backfilled the cycle 8 develop history entry's commit hash (was null, actual is 8121371).

Reviewed commit 426cb47 (commaQty display fix) — this exact fix was independently implemented in parallel by two concurrent app-evolve runs (the cloud routine and a local run), both picking up the same banked candidate from cycle 4's critique notes at nearly the same time. Reconciled via `git merge origin/main` (not reset, to avoid discarding either side's work): kept origin's already-pushed implementation as canonical, and merged in the genuinely additive part of the local work — regression test coverage. While wiring commaQty into test/run.js, found and fixed a real, separate bug in the test harness itself: extractConst() preserved the leading 'const ' keyword, but Node's vm.runInContext() does not attach top-level const/let bindings to the context object (only function declarations and plain assignments do), so anything routed through CONSTS was silently unreachable as sandbox.<name>. Stripped the 'const ' prefix so extracted consts become plain global assignments. Added 'comma'/'commaQty' to CONSTS and 3 new test cases. All 18 tests now pass. Lesson recorded for future concurrent-execution cycles: check git fetch/log origin/main immediately before push, prefer git merge over reset --hard (which the permission classifier blocks anyway).

Stepped back from the bug-fixing pattern of the last several cycles to look for a genuine product gap rather than another small bug. Found one: DB.budgets is initialized as an empty object in migrate() but that single line is its ONLY reference anywhere in the codebase (verified via grep) — nothing ever reads or writes it, and the .budget-card CSS class is likewise defined but never used in any template. Meanwhile spendByCategory()/openSpendAnalysis() (the existing '지출 분석' sheet) already compute and display per-category spending for the month with a progress-bar UI, just relative to total spend rather than any budget limit. This is a half-built core feature of a budget-tracking app — the data model was scaffolded but the actual budget-setting UX was never connected. No code changed this phase (as intended for critique) — wrote a concrete plan to pending_advance_plan: extend the existing openSpendAnalysis() sheet (rather than building a new screen) to let the user tap a category row to set a monthly budget limit stored in DB.budgets[category], switch that row's progress bar to show usage-vs-budget (clamped, highlighted red when over 100%) while categories without a set budget keep today's behavior unchanged, and add regression tests for the percentage math including the divide-by-zero edge case.

Implemented cycle 5's critique plan: connected the previously-dead DB.budgets scaffolding to a real feature by extending the existing openSpendAnalysis() ('지출 분석') sheet instead of building a new screen. Tapping a category row now opens openBudgetPrompt(idx), which reads/writes DB.budgets[category] via saveBudget()/delBudget(). Extracted the percentage math into a pure budgetProgress(spent,budget) helper: when a budget is set, the row's progress bar switches from 'share of total spend' to 'usage vs budget' (clamped to 100% width so the bar never overflows), turns from --brand to --expense once spending exceeds the budget, and the amount/percentage text also gets the --expense highlight; categories with no budget keep today's total-share behavior unchanged. doRenameCat() now migrates DB.budgets[old]->DB.budgets[new] on expense-category rename, mirroring the existing catIcon/catVar migration pattern (delCat leaves orphaned budget entries alone, same as it already does for catIcon/catVar). Added 6 new regression tests (budgetProgress edge cases including the 0-budget divide-by-zero guard and the >100% clamp, plus the rename-migrates-budget case) — all 24 tests pass. Bumped APP_VERSION 1.17.3->1.17.4 and sw.js CACHE v38->v39.

delCat(k,i) only spliced the category out of DB.categories[k] but never cleaned up DB.catIcon[catKey(k,c)], DB.catVar[catKey(k,c)], or (for expense) DB.budgets[c] — the exact same class of orphaned-parallel-map bug that doRenameCat already had to fix for rename, but delete was never given the same treatment. Since catKey is purely name-based, deleting a category (e.g. '커피' with a custom icon, a '변동' flag, and a 30,000원 budget) and later re-adding one with the same name silently inherited the old icon/variable-flag/budget the user never set. Extracted the deletion body into doDeleteCat(k,i), mirroring doRenameCat's migration pattern, which now also deletes the catIcon/catVar entries and (for k==='expense') the budgets entry for the deleted category name; delCat() just calls it inside the existing confirmSheet callback. Added 3 new regression tests to test/run.js (icon/var/budget cleanup on delete, no inheritance on same-name re-add, and a guard that non-expense types don't touch DB.budgets) — all 27 tests pass. Verified both inline <script> blocks still parse via `new Function()`. Bumped APP_VERSION 1.17.4→1.17.5 and sw.js CACHE v39→v40.

Reviewed commit 6aba2c4 (doDeleteCat cleanup fix). Verified doDeleteCat mirrors doRenameCat's existing catIcon/catVar/budgets migration pattern correctly (same catKey-based lookups, same expense-only guard for DB.budgets), confirmed migrate() always initializes DB.catIcon/catVar/budgets so the new deletes are never against undefined objects, checked there is no second category-deletion code path that bypasses doDeleteCat (delCat is the only caller of DB.categories[k].splice), re-ran the regression suite (27/27 pass) and re-validated both inline <script> blocks parse via new Function(). No bugs found — no code changes this phase.

Stepped back to look at the whole app rather than the last commit. Found the app has no net-worth history/trend view at all — only ever shows a single 'now' snapshot — and the codebase itself shows this was started and abandoned: orphaned comments at index.html lines 159/167/1912/1914 ('① 현금흐름 곡선 카드', '현금흐름 곡선 그리기 (canvas)') plus a dead .fc-chart canvas CSS rule, with zero implementing function or <canvas> element anywhere (confirmed via grep). Also noted a structural gap that constrains the fix: DB.rates only stores a current price snapshot, no history, so any trend implementation must snapshot already-evaluated totals (via assetEval()/netWorth()) rather than trying to recompute past non-cash asset values from today's rates. Runner-up candidates noted but not chosen: accessibility is essentially absent (5 total aria-/role=/alt=/tabindex hits across 5172 lines), local auth password hashing is an unsalted djb2 hash (low real-world risk, local-only), and there's no CSV/spreadsheet export (JSON backup/restore only). Wrote the net-worth-history plan to pending_advance_plan for the next advance cycle. No code changed this phase.

Implemented cycle 6's critique plan: connected the net-worth history gap by adding DB.nwHistory=DB.nwHistory||[] to migrate() and two pure functions — updateNwHistory(hist,dateStr,ta,td) (append-or-update-today, immutable) and pruneNwHistory(hist) (keeps daily granularity for the most recent 90 days, compresses anything older to one snapshot per month, only kicks in above 120 entries so normal usage never touches it). Wired the snapshot into startApp() (covers first-ever open and every reopen, refreshing today's entry) and into refreshToday()'s day-changed branch (covers the app staying open across midnight) — both call save() right after, matching the existing changed-then-save() convention. Added nwChartPath(pts,W,H), a pure function producing an SVG path string (min/max-normalized, span-zero-safe) with no chart library, and nwHistoryCard() which renders it as an inline <svg> sparkline card (shown only once ≥2 snapshots exist) inserted into renderAssets() right after the net-worth carousel. Replaced the entire dead cash-flow-curve CSS block (.flow-card/.fc-head/.fc-lb/.fc-end/.fc-sub/.fc-chart/.fc-foot/.fc-stat/.fs-k/.fs-v — verified via grep that none of these classes were referenced anywhere outside their own definitions) with real .nwh-card/.nwh-range/.nwh-chart rules, and replaced the orphaned '① 현금흐름 곡선 카드' / '현금흐름 곡선 그리기 (canvas)' comments with the real nwHistoryCard() implementation, putting the previously-unused shortDate2() helper to actual use. Added 8 new regression tests (updateNwHistory append/update-in-place/immutability, pruneNwHistory below-threshold and month-compression behavior, nwChartPath's <2-points/flat-line/rising-line cases) — all 35 tests pass. Verified both inline <script> blocks still parse via new Function(). Bumped APP_VERSION 1.17.5→1.18.0 and sw.js CACHE v40→v41 (minor bump, not patch, since this adds a new schema field and a new UI section rather than fixing a bug).

addCat(k) was the odd one out among the app's 'add/rename named item' flows: addOwner() and doRenameCat() both check for a duplicate name and toast('이미 있는 카테고리예요'/'이미 있는 귀속이에요') before returning, but addCat() just silently skipped the DB.categories[k].push() on a duplicate and still cleared the draft, saved, and reopened the sheet — giving the user zero feedback that nothing happened when they typed an existing category name. Worse, if the user had picked a custom icon in catAddDraft.icon first, the DB.catIcon[catKey(k,v)]=catAddDraft.icon line still ran unconditionally, silently overwriting the icon of the pre-existing category with the same name. Fixed by adding the same early-return-with-toast guard used by addOwner/doRenameCat, which also fixes the icon-overwrite side effect since the function now returns before touching catIcon. Added addCat to the test harness's FUNCTIONS list and gave the sandbox toast() a lastToast recorder (previously a no-op) plus a catAddDraft field so it could be exercised; added 2 new regression tests (duplicate name toasts and leaves array/icon untouched; new name adds normally with no toast) — all 37 tests pass.
